name: duga-platform
description: De Ultimate Glory Academy — digital platform (marketing site + school portal) monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,portal -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @duga/web" "npm run dev -w @duga/portal"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @duga/db && npm run build -w @duga/core && npm run build -w @duga/ui && npm run build -w @duga/web && npm run build -w @duga/portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @duga/web && npm run typecheck -w @duga/portal && npm run typecheck -w @duga/core && npm run typecheck -w @duga/ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @duga/web && npm run lint -w @duga/portal
